# Closed runtime signature Nat study

These two informed, zero-authored-qubit source experiments use ordinary
non-generic runtime functions. Both declare an exact empty-register interface.
The first ordinary size expression has an intermediate above u32 capacity and
is refused before proposal materialization. This is a representation-capacity
failure, not wrapping arithmetic or a different mathematical Nat meaning.

The second source uses an existing checked affine helper. Its signed i128
template returns exact zero under its unchanged final u32 contract. The actual
CLI accepts the concrete project: 2 local and 9 bundled roots, 20 fresh native
decisions, zero independent requests. Native structure/ownership/interface/
scope/execution-view checks do not prove source preservation or an arbitrary
Meaning. The first prediction and all actual stdout/stderr remain unchanged.

The selected binary digest and observed dirty Git HEAD identify separate
objects; this is not a clean commit-to-binary build attestation. Both input
windows and the selected binary/kernel remained stable. No generic admission,
maximum-size case, new primitive, guarantee, release approval or full
QS/PR/RS/EXACT discharge is claimed. The retention reader never executes the
recorded commands or source. Current regression tests invoke their own APIs.
